I need all IC50 activity measurements for the compound dapagliflozin (including its salt forms) against the target sodium/glucose cotransporter 1 (SGLT1). Include the following details:

- Compound information: preferred name, ChEMBL ID, and canonical SMILES.
- Activity data: standard value, standard units, pchembl value, and relation.
- Assay descriptions: the description of the assay.
- Literature references: document title, journal, year, authors, and PubMed ID (or DOI if PubMed ID is not available).

For the target, use the protein sodium/glucose cotransporter 1, which should be identified by its pref_name in the target dictionary.

For the compound, start with dapagliflozin and expand to include all its salt forms using the molecule hierarchy (parent-child relationships). Do not restrict by organism or unit type.

Return all matching rows with the columns listed above.
sql: WITH dapa_parent AS (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE UPPER(pref_name) = 'DAPAGLIFLOZIN'), compound_molregnos AS (SELECT molregno FROM dapa_parent UNION SELECT mh.molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy mh, dapa_parent dp WHERE mh.parent_molregno = dp.molregno) SELECT md.pref_name AS compound_pref_name, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_relation AS relation, ass.description AS assay_description, d.title AS doc_title, d.journal, d.year, d.authors, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi FROM activities a JOIN compound_molregnos cm ON a.molregno = cm.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND td.pref_name = 'Sodium/glucose cotransporter 1';
